controls.title: IAM statements name their actions and resources
controls.statement: Every IAM policy statement grants named actions on named resources; a wildcard action or wildcard resource on a write, delete or permission-changing action fails.
controls.look_for: Policy documents or aws_iam_policy_document blocks with "Action": "*", "Resource": "*", service:* actions or AdministratorAccess on a workload role.

controls.title: Role trust policies name their principals
controls.statement: Every IAM role trust policy names the exact principals allowed to assume the role; an open principal, or a whole-account principal without a condition, fails.
controls.look_for: assume_role_policy or AssumeRolePolicyDocument with "AWS": "*", identifiers ["*"], or an account root principal with no Condition block.

controls.title: No long-lived access keys
controls.statement: No long-lived IAM access keys are created for people, or for workloads that can use a role or a federated identity instead.
controls.look_for: aws_iam_access_key resources, AWS::IAM::AccessKey, or access key ids passed to a workload through configuration.

controls.title: The root user has no keys and runs no automation
controls.statement: The account root user or break-glass identity has no access keys and is not used by any automation in the change.
controls.look_for: Root access keys, automation that signs in as root, or pipelines whose credentials belong to the root user.

controls.title: Privileged sign-in needs a second factor
controls.statement: Human sign-in to a privileged IAM role or IAM Identity Center permission set requires a second factor.
controls.look_for: Privileged roles assumable by people with no aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent condition; Identity Center settings that turn MFA off.

controls.title: Permissions attach to roles or groups
controls.statement: IAM permissions attach to roles or groups, never directly to individual IAM users.
controls.look_for: aws_iam_user_policy, aws_iam_user_policy_attachment or inline Policies on an AWS::IAM::User.

controls.title: Roles that change IAM, keys or logging carry a boundary
controls.statement: A new IAM role that can change IAM, KMS key policies or logging configuration carries a permissions boundary or an equivalent guard.
controls.look_for: Roles granted iam:*, kms:PutKeyPolicy, cloudtrail:StopLogging or logs:Delete* with no permissions_boundary.

controls.title: Password policy needs length and blocks reuse
controls.statement: An IAM account password policy set by the change requires at least 14 characters and blocks password reuse.
controls.look_for: aws_iam_account_password_policy with minimum_password_length under 14 or no password_reuse_prevention.

controls.title: No administrative port open to the internet
controls.statement: No security group or network ACL ingress rule opens an administrative port (SSH, RDP, database ports) to any internet address.

controls.title: Default security groups allow nothing
controls.statement: The default security group and default network ACL of a VPC allow no traffic in either direction.
controls.look_for: aws_default_security_group or aws_default_network_acl blocks holding ingress or egress rules, or a new VPC whose default group is left open.

controls.title: Egress is limited to what the workload needs
controls.statement: Security group egress is limited to the destinations the workload needs; an allow-all egress rule on a workload holding sensitive data fails.
controls.look_for: egress blocks with protocol -1 to 0.0.0.0/0 on groups attached to databases, key services or data processors.

controls.title: Flow logs on every new VPC or subnet
controls.statement: VPC flow logging is on for every new VPC or subnet the change creates.
controls.look_for: A new aws_vpc or aws_subnet with no aws_flow_log naming it.

controls.title: Storage and database endpoints stay private
controls.statement: Storage and database endpoints are private by default; public access needs an explicit, documented exception in the change.
controls.look_for: publicly_accessible = true on a database, public subnets for data stores, or map_public_ip_on_launch on private tiers.

controls.title: Public endpoints take TLS 1.2 or later only
controls.statement: API Gateway, load balancer and CloudFront endpoints reachable from outside accept TLS 1.2 or later only and reject plain HTTP except to redirect.
controls.look_for: security_policy TLS_1_0, ssl_policy or minimum_protocol_version below TLS 1.2, or HTTP listeners that serve content.

controls.title: Instance metadata needs session tokens
controls.statement: EC2 instances and launch templates require IMDSv2 session tokens, so a request forgery bug cannot read workload credentials.
controls.look_for: Instances or launch templates with no metadata_options block, or http_tokens other than required.

controls.title: CloudTrail records every region and global events
controls.statement: CloudTrail records control-plane API activity in every region the account uses, including global service events.
controls.look_for: aws_cloudtrail with is_multi_region_trail false or include_global_service_events false, or a trail removed.

controls.title: Trail log files are integrity-protected
controls.statement: CloudTrail log file validation is on, so a later change or deletion of a log file is detectable.
controls.look_for: A trail with enable_log_file_validation false or absent.

controls.title: Audit log storage denies delete and overwrite
controls.statement: The S3 bucket or log group that holds audit logs denies deletion and overwrite to the workloads it records.
controls.look_for: Trail buckets with no Object Lock or deny statement, or application roles granted s3:DeleteObject or logs:DeleteLogGroup on log stores.

controls.title: Log groups state a retention period
controls.statement: CloudWatch log groups and log buckets have a stated retention period that meets the project's declared standard; unbounded or zero retention fails.
controls.look_for: aws_cloudwatch_log_group with no retention_in_days, or lifecycle rules that delete audit logs early.

controls.title: Alarms on root use, IAM changes, key loss and logging off
controls.statement: Alarms exist for root or break-glass use, IAM policy changes, KMS key disable or deletion, and CloudTrail being turned off.
controls.look_for: Metric filters and alarms for these events removed, or new accounts with none.

controls.title: Application logs carry no secrets or personal data
controls.statement: Application logs carry no secrets, tokens, key material or personal data, and request bodies are not logged by default.
controls.look_for: Log or print calls that pass passwords, tokens, keys, request bodies or personal fields.

controls.title: New storage is encrypted at rest
controls.statement: Every new storage resource (S3 bucket, EBS volume, RDS or DynamoDB table, SQS queue, CloudWatch log group, Secrets Manager secret) is encrypted at rest.
controls.look_for: Storage resources with encryption off, encrypted = false, or no server-side encryption setting where the service default is off.

controls.title: Customer-managed keys rotate
controls.statement: Customer-managed KMS keys have automatic rotation turned on.
controls.look_for: aws_kms_key with enable_key_rotation false or absent on a symmetric key.

controls.title: Key policies name users and administrators
controls.statement: KMS key policies name the principals that may use and administer a key, and no single principal holds both roles without a stated reason.
controls.look_for: Key policies granting kms:* to a principal, or one role that both administers and uses a key.

controls.title: Backups, snapshots and replicas stay encrypted and private
controls.statement: DynamoDB backups and replicas, EBS and RDS snapshots inherit encryption and are never shared publicly.
controls.look_for: Snapshot permissions naming all, unencrypted copies or replicas, or restore paths that drop the key.

controls.title: Buckets block public access and require TLS
controls.statement: S3 buckets block public access at the bucket or account level, and their policies deny requests that do not use TLS.
controls.look_for: Buckets with no public access block, block flags set false, public ACLs, or no aws:SecureTransport deny.

controls.title: Images come from a pinned digest or version
controls.statement: Container images come from a pinned digest or pinned version in a trusted registry, never a floating latest tag.
controls.look_for: image references ending in :latest or with no tag, FROM lines with no digest, or mutable ECR tags.

controls.title: Containers run as a non-root user
controls.statement: ECS tasks and other containers run as a non-root user and drop the Linux capabilities they do not need.
controls.look_for: Task definitions with no user or user root, Dockerfiles with no USER line, or capabilities added.

controls.title: Containers are not privileged and share no host namespace
controls.statement: Containers do not run privileged, do not share the host network, PID or IPC namespace, and do not mount the container runtime socket.
controls.look_for: privileged true, networkMode host, pidMode or ipcMode host, or docker.sock mounts.

controls.title: Container root filesystems are read-only
controls.statement: The root filesystem of a container is read-only where the workload allows, with writable paths named explicitly.
controls.look_for: Task definitions with readonlyRootFilesystem false or absent.

controls.title: Secrets reach functions and containers from a secret store
controls.statement: Secrets reach a Lambda function, container or host through Secrets Manager, SSM Parameter Store or a mounted file, never through an image layer, a build argument or a plain environment variable.
controls.look_for: Secret values in environment blocks, ARG or ENV lines holding secrets, or secrets copied into an image.

controls.title: Hosts and images are patched on a schedule
controls.statement: EC2 hosts and images receive security patches through an automated, scheduled path stated in the change or the project's standards.
controls.look_for: New hosts or AMIs with no patch baseline, maintenance window or image rebuild schedule.

controls.title: Remote shell uses keys or federation
controls.statement: Remote shell access to hosts uses key, SSM Session Manager or federated authentication; password login and direct root login are off.
controls.look_for: PasswordAuthentication yes, PermitRootLogin yes, or shared key pairs in user data.

controls.title: Unused services and packages are not installed
controls.statement: Services and packages the workload does not use are not installed, or are disabled, in the image or host configuration.
controls.look_for: Package installs or enabled services in user data or Dockerfiles that the workload never uses.
controls.verify: rg -n 'apt-get install|yum install|dnf install|apk add|systemctl enable' -g '*.tf' -g '*.json' -g '*.yaml' -g '*.yml' -g '*.sh' -g '*Dockerfile*' .
